Thanks Dylan — reviewed the materials and HubSpot notes. Recommendation and conditional approval:

- APPROVE quarterly consolidated invoicing (one invoice per calendar quarter). This materially reduces AP overhead for the buyer and is acceptable commercially.
- APPROVE extended payment term, but with a staged approach: Net-60 for the first two quarters, then Net-90 thereafter pending no missed payments and successful reference verification. If Merchantway provides a CFO credit intake memo or bank reference, we can fast-track to Net-90 immediately.

Conditions / actions before contracting:
1) Finance to add a clause for staged payment terms into SOW/Billing Addendum and set up an automated aging alert at 45 days to trigger account manager outreach.
2) Legal to add invoicing cadence language + acceptance that consolidated invoices may have different service dates.
3) Require PO and signed SOW before start of services.

Rishi — please include a 30-day lookback collection play and confirm there is no material credit risk. Dylan — you can communicate the conditional approval back to the customer and request the CFO memo referenced by Jordan.

- Grace
